6173.title: Recursive skill discovery exhausts its scan budget
6173.rootCauseOneLine: Recursive skill scans count unrelated regular files and share a single entry budget across roots, hiding later skills.
6173.proposedFix: Scope recursive traversal budgets per root and count only candidate directories while preserving nested discovery and existing path protections.
6173.caveats: Synthetic Linux filesystem reproduction; no live macOS, native Pi, or UI run. Same agent repeated the reproduction in a second clean checkout. Directory and depth limits remain intentional.
